title: Synthesis of Z-scheme Ag4V2O7/Ag3VO4/GO nanocomposites for photocatalytic degradation of DDT under visible light
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7078-7089
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00134J, Paper

Giang H. Le, Duong A. Thanh, Trang T. T. Pham, Quang Vinh Tran, Nhiem Ngoc Dao, Kien Trung Nguyen, Trang T. T. Quan
AVGZ nanorods enhance light absorption, achieving 95.46% DDT degradation under LED light. EPR confirms ·OH and ·O2− as key oxidants. The proposed Z-scheme mechanism ensures superior charge separation and stability.
